question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.**

If a person commits a crime with (malice) ______, they did it on purpose.
solution: The correct answer is '**goodwill**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**malice**' is '**goodwill**'. • **Malice**: a wish to hurt other people. (दूसरों को मानसिक पीड़ा पहुँचाने की अभिलाषा, दुर्भावना) • *Example: I bear no **malice** towards him.* • **Goodwill**: friendly, helpful feelings towards other people. (दूसरों के प्रति सद्‌भाव) • *Example: The visit was designed to promote friendship and **goodwill**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Goodwill.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **rancour**: bitterness or resentfulness, especially when long standing. (विद्वेष) • **disdain**: the feeling that somebody/something is not good enough to be respected. (यह भावना कि कोई सम्मानीय नहीं है, तिरस्‍कार, अवज्ञा) • **disgust**: a strong feeling of not liking or approving of something/somebody that you feel is unacceptable, or something/somebody that looks, smells, etc. unpleasant. (प्रबल अनिच्‍छा, जुगुप्‍सा) 3b:Tbb2, The correct answer is '**abrupt**'.
